selection_method: Set A: committed E2 sheet (180); Set B: committed retained-string adjudication (203); Set C: committed terminology adjudication (20, anchored to representative segments); Set D: >= 40 additional translated non-identity rows per surface, tiered by risk/length then sorted by segment_id with stride sampling (deterministic, no RNG)
notes: Reviewer/user decision columns are deliberately empty in the shipped package.
All segment_ids are canonical import ids; terminology rows anchor to a representative segment.
